summary.zh: 把规范文档转成带目录和搜索的网页
summary.en: Long-form markdown into one HTML page with search

description.zh: 把规范、RFC、报告或方案这类长文 markdown 转成单个 HTML 页面，带固定目录、全文搜索和代码块复制。适合需要把文档发给别人阅读、又不想依赖在线平台的时候。转换前需先设定品牌样式。
description.en: Converts long-form markdown such as specs, RFCs, reports or plans into one HTML page with a sticky table of contents, search and code copy. Good for sharing readable docs without a hosting platform.
